name: Null Moon
description: A moon launched by Thran artificers that gathered white mana for millennia.

description_citations.text: "Yawgmoth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth arrives and the final battle begins; channeling the Null Moon's mana fails to kill him.

citation.text: "Apocalypse", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's head proposes recreating Serra's Realm, but Karn tells of the Null Moon, and the Weatherlight planeshifts there to gather white mana.
timeline.quote: Weatherlight planeshifts to that moon and gathers the mana within

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The defenders break open the Null Moon and sacrifice the Weatherlight to strike Yawgmoth, who survives by hiding in the volcano.
timeline.quote: Sacrificing the Weatherlight to channel this immense energy, they struck Yawgmoth’s form.

citation.text: "Black Cloud of Death", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Betrayers escape the Shard after Chromium and Ravidel die at the Summit of the Null Moon.
timeline.quote: No planeswalker died, but the deaths of Chromium Rhuell and Ravidel proved enough to let the betrayers escape.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Ice Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight absorbs the Null Moon's white mana and the moon is destroyed.
timeline.quote: The moon was destroyed, and Dominaria's night sky was changed forever.

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "First Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Faralyn hosts the Summit of the Null Moon with the planeswalkers trapped in the Shard.
timeline.quote: For ten centuries, they have been trapped within a tiny formation of twelve worlds

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat kills Chromium Rhuell with Dark Banishing and combat breaks out.
timeline.quote: Szat follows through with Dark Banishing , killing the mighty dragon.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Faralyn uses Rhuell's death energy to open the rift; Lim-Dul escapes and Leshrac kills Ravidel with Fire Covenant.
timeline.quote: Leshrac casts Fire Covenant , bringing fiery harm to all present and killing Ravidel.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Kristina and Taysir resurrect Ravidel, who declares Kristina his enemy.
timeline.quote: He doesn't agree with Kristina changing his fate and declares her his enemy forever.

citation.work: Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering
citation.text: "Ice Age on the World of Magic: The Gathering", section "The Shard". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yawgmoth takes control of the Null Sphere in the Battle of the Null Sphere and turns artifact creatures on their masters.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth took control of it in what is known as the Battle of the Null Sphere

citation.text: "Null Moon", section "Null Sphere". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sphere's operators rebel and jettison it into orbit; the stonechargers wipe out Yawgmoth's army and mutate survivors into warped Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: the irradiative cloud released by the stonechargers mutated the survivors into the iconically warped Phyrexians

citation.text: "Null Moon", section "Null Sphere". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A planeswalkers' summit on the moon called by Faralyn descends into violence and begins the Planeswalkers' War.
timeline.quote: which descended into violence and began the Planeswalkers' War

citation.text: "Null Moon", section "Null Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard flies the Weatherlight through the moon, channeling its white mana into Yawgmoth; it fails to kill him and ends the Weatherlight's consciousness.
timeline.quote: only resulted in the death of Weatherlight' s consciousness

citation.text: "Null Moon", section "Null Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat and Leshrac arrive on the Null Moon and Leshrac convinces Szat to imprison Daria in an Amber Prison rather than kill her.
timeline.quote: proposing that she instead be imprisoned within an Amber Prison .

citation.text: "Planeswalker War", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Szat and Leshrac arrive on the Null Moon and put Daria in an Amber Prison instead of killing her.
timeline.quote: So instead he puts the girl in an Amber Prison .

citation.text: "Prelude to War", section "Planeswalker in Amber , by Jeff Grubb and Rags Morales". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Gerrard puncture the Null Moon, Gerrard completes the Legacy, and a sentient light kills Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: dissolving and killing him at last.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: Such was the wonder of Glacian ’s design.
